name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  August 13, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Chambers,
9th Floor, on August 13, 2026, at 2:30 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, City Clerk Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Councilwoman Dionne Faulk on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host a Let’s Get
  Healthy Dance Class Event at 2900 w. Imperial Hwy. Private Property , on Thursday,
  August 20, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Approval for a one (1) day event,
  Inglewood Police Department will provide two (2) officers for Public Safety; watch
  Commander will be notified and extra patrol as time permits; Maintain the site at all
  times, ensuring the site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of each day;All
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective
  personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA
  County and CA State Health Department; and  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  but not limited to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and
  the California Disabled Persons Act. permits. Adhere to all local, state, and federal
  laws; No additional recommendations needed for Fire approval; Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No.266537)
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
